note: County-owned recreation area wrapped around WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca, run by the raceway's operator: paved and dirt camp loops on oak hillsides above the track, with trails into Fort Ord National Monument. Bring drinking water. Race weekends are ticketed event camping and fill up; non-race days can be loud with track sessions. --Claude
summary: Operator camping page + 2025 non-event guide PDF + bookmysites engine API + Google read. Open year-round (dry Grand Prix loop May-Oct); 164 sites (93 water/30 A electric at $56-61, 71 dry at $55); sewer stored true -> false (W/E only, dump station); water non-potable; max 40 ft. Local (county-owned), no private gate; Google 4.3/245. Phone '' -> 831-242-8200; website (county page + dead lagunaseca.com) -> weathertechraceway.com/pages/camping. Pin fine.
flags: HOOKUPS: stored sewer true -> false. Operator guide: 'UTILITY CAMPING 30- Amp Electrical/Water' and 'Dumping station is located at the top of "A" Road'; engine: 'Sites include non-potable water & 30 amp electricity'. No sewer site in any type. Electric 30 added.
WATER: 'All water sources/hookups have NON-POTABLE water. Campers are responsible for supplying their own drinking water.' - potable_water false, worth the note's warning.
SITES: stored 96 (note prose) -> 164 (engine: Chaparral 72, Can-Am 21, Grand Prix 71). Unnumbered general event camping at Turns 9-11 is race-weekend only and not counted.

EVENTS: the campgrounds switch to ticketed event camping on race weekends ('All campers (except children under 15) must have an admission ticket for the duration of the event'; 2027 dates April 15-18, April 30-May 2, May 6-8, July 9-11, August 7-8, August 11-14, September 3-5). Ordinary nights are sold online year-round outside those dates, so a normal campground with an event overlay, not an event-only lot.
OPERATOR: owned by the County of Monterey ('owned by the County of Monterey'), run by the raceway's operator (waiver names Friends of Laguna Seca and Racing Operations LLC). Ownership local kept.

PRICE: local (county-owned), so the private $50 gate doesn't apply; for reference the cheapest RV night is $55 dry / $56 water-and-electric (2026-11-27 engine). Google Maps: 4.3 stars, 245 reviews. Long-stay: weekly/monthly prices are posted but the 15-day stay limit caps any stay.
PHONE: '' -> 831-242-8200 (ticket and camping office; operator page, guide, engine and Google agree).

WEBSITE: 'https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/.../laguna-seca-recreation-area' + 'https://lagunaseca.com' -> https://weathertechraceway.com/pages/camping (operator camping page). lagunaseca.com no longer resolves; the county page 403s and has no Wayback capture, unread. Booking engine in booking.url.
